messages.text: The local source confirms that eza’s behavior is split across option parsing, filesystem metadata, filtering/sorting, and view renderers; matching only the visible listing format would miss parser and error semantics. Before implementation, I’m narrowing those stable boundaries and will establish `architect.md` plus a differential harness so every change is judged against the official binary rather than hand-picked assumptions.
